newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-ALBERT OVERLOOKED AGAIN BY BELGIUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBERT OVERLOOKED AGAIN BY BELGIUM.

text.p: Belgian coach Wilfried Van Moer continued to ignore Newcastle defender Philippe Albert when he named his 18-man squad for the World Cup qualifier against San Marino on Wednesday.
Van Moer kept faith with the squad which beat Turkey 2-1 in their opening qualifying match in August, although he did not rule out the possibility of Albert returning later in the campaign.
Captain Enzo Scifo, who fractured toe playing for Monaco on Wednesday, was the only notable absentee. He has been replaced by Club Brugge's Lorenzo Staelens.
"We have to win, otherwise it's a disaster," said Van Moer, who will announce his starting line-up on Tuesday.
Goalkeepers - Filip De Wilde (Sporting Lisbon), Philippe Vande Walle (Ekeren)
Defenders - Geoffrey Claeys (Feyenoord), Bertrand Crasson (Napoli), Pascal Renier (Club Brugge), Eric Deflandre (Club Brugge), Dirk Medved (Club Brugge)
Midfielders - Frederic Peiremans (Anderlecht), Lorenzo Staelens (Club Brugge), Gunther Schepens (Standard Liege), Nico Van Kerckhoven (Lierse), Gert Verheyen (Club Brugge), Philippe Leonard (Monaco)
Strikers - Gilles De Bilde (Anderlecht), Luc Nilis (PSV Eindhoven), Luis Oliveira (Fiorentina), Marc Degryse (PSV Eindhoven), Frederic Pierre (Molenbeek)
